meta.name: Eagle Point Welding
meta.description: Machine-readable design system. Agents read this as the source of truth for tokens and component patterns. Mirrors src/styles/global.css. Dark, monochrome, industrial. Live preview at /styleguide.
meta.tailwindNote: Surface/text/line tokens are exposed as Tailwind color utilities via @theme in global.css: bg-base, bg-surface, text-ink, text-ink-dim, border-line.

display.use: All headings (h1–h4) and any large display text. Glyphs are uppercase-only and condensed.

body.use: Body copy, UI labels, eyebrows, buttons, nav.

fonts.serifRemoved: The reference site's Lora serif was intentionally dropped — never reintroduce a serif.

base.use: Primary page background and alternating sections.

panel.use: Solid content panel placed over a full-bleed photo (e.g. the image band).

colors.palette: Strictly monochrome — black, grays, white. No accent/brand color. Color comes only from photography.

h1.size: clamp(2.75rem … 4.375rem) globally; hero overrides to text-[3.5rem] sm:text-[4.5rem] lg:text-[5rem]
h1.note: Bebas renders as caps. Force editorial line breaks with <br class='hidden sm:block'>.

h2.use: Section headings (Latest projects, Services, What do you need to build?).

eyebrow.classes: .eyebrow (Work Sans, 15px, weight 500, uppercase, letter-spacing 1.35px, leading dash via ::before)
eyebrow.use: Kicker above headlines (The Standard in Metalwork, Get in touch, Nick Coleman, Owner/Operator).

link.classes: color: inherit; no underline by default — links are styled as buttons or nav items.

borderRadius.all: 0px — everything is square. Do not add rounded corners.

effects.shadows: None. Depth comes from photography + dark gradient overlays, not shadows.

imageOverlay.vertical: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(0,0,0,0.9) 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0.5) 55%, rgba(0,0,0,0.35) 100%) — hero/CTA over media
imageOverlay.diagonal: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.88) 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0.6) 45%, rgba(0,0,0,0.25) 100%) — service tiles, keeps top-left text legible

hero-video.description: Full-bleed muted autoplay/loop background <video> (poster fallback) + vertical dark gradient. Content bottom-left: eyebrow, big Bebas headline, 21px body, outline button. Section min-h-[80vh] lg:min-h-[82vh], content justify-end.

project-card.description: Image (aspect-[3/2], border-white/10) with hover scale-105 → Bebas h3 title → 15px body → .btn-outline-sm 'View project'. 3-up grid on lg.

service-tile.description: Tall tile (min-h-[420px] lg:min-h-[480px]) with full-bleed photo + diagonal dark overlay; Bebas h3 + 15px body anchored top-left. 2-up grid.

image-panel-band.description: Full-bleed background photo with a solid black content panel (max-w-md, p-10/12) offset to the container's left edge holding heading + body + outline button.
image-panel-band.reference: index.astro 'Real pictures of our work' band

about-split.description: Two-column on bg-surface: left = Bebas headline + eyebrow byline + body; right = photo with a small uppercase caption pinned bottom-right.

cta-centered.description: Centered eyebrow + Bebas headline + body + outline button over a full-bleed photo with a vertical dark gradient.
